caption: The video captures a stainless steel pot resting on a gas stove burner, filled with water that is already at a rolling boil. From behind a person in a black long-sleeved garment, whose shoulder and arm occupy the left edge of the frame, the view looks down over a white marble-patterned countertop cluttered with kitchen items—a metal bowl, a round lid, a blue-topped box, a teal tray holding bottles, striped oven mitts, a green cloth, and a wooden rolling pin. Inside the pot, the surface churns continuously, with bubbles rising and breaking into patches of pale foam that drift and reform across the water. Steam hazes the upper rim. The camera makes small, steady tilts and shifts, nudging the pot and the background objects up and down within the frame without settling into a fixed angle. Throughout, the figure on the left stays essentially still. The person offers no interaction with the pot. The boiling simply carries on past the final frame, neither starting nor stopping within the visible excerpt.
relations: Water in the stainless steel pot on the burner boils continuously, forming drifting pale foam.
The person in black on the left remains still, offering no interaction with the pot.
The camera makes small tilts and shifts, nudging the pot and background objects within the frame.
Steam from the boiling water hazes the upper rim of the pot.
